import pytest

from subject import (
    stratum_of,

    ModelShadowReviewCandidate,

# Helper to create a basic candidate
def make_candidate(
    key: str = "pr-1",
    repo: str = "public-repo",
    title: str = "feat: add feature",
    author: str = "user",
    author_is_bot: bool = False,
    watcher_class: str = "watcher",
    evidence_companion: bool = False,
    created_at: datetime | None = None,
) -> ModelShadowReviewCandidate:
    if created_at is None:
        created_at = datetime(2024, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return ModelShadowReviewCandidate(
        key=key,
        repo=repo,
        title=title,
        author=author,
        author_is_bot=author_is_bot,
        watcher_class=watcher_class,
        evidence_companion=evidence_companion,
        created_at=created_at,
    )


def make_policy(
    public_repos: set[str] | None = None,
    private_repos: set[str] | None = None,
    excluded_repos: set[str] | None = None,
    companion_authors: set[str] | None = None,
    window_start: datetime | None = None,
    public_cap: int = 60,
    max_reviews_per_tick: int = 10,
) -> ModelShadowReviewPolicy:
    return ModelShadowReviewPolicy(
        public_repos=public_repos or {"public-repo"},
        private_repos=private_repos or {"private-repo"},
        excluded_repos=excluded_repos or {"excluded-repo"},
        companion_authors=companion_authors or {"bot-author"},
        window_start=window_start,
        public_cap=public_cap,
        max_reviews_per_tick=max_reviews_per_tick,
    )
